adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `next`/`previous` actions immediately mutate `group.offset` (`group.set("offset", offset);`) and then call `group.findMembers()` without any error handling or request coordination. In `discourse/models/group.js`, `findMembers()` performs an async AJAX request and only updates `members/offset` on success; on failure it leaves the new `offset` in place while `members` remains from the prior page, making `currentPage`/UI inconsistent. Also, multiple rapid clicks can trigger overlapping `findMembers()` calls; since each success handler blindly `setProperties(...)`, responses can arrive out of order and an older response can overwrite a newer page’s members/offset. The diff shows no rollback/blocking/cancellation logic.
